snippet.title: BadZone demo release trailer
snippet.description:
After years of hard work, we are proud to release our first ever playable demo of our project BadZone!

We hope you'll find joy by experiencing intense fights with the first two playable characters available now on patreon for free!

Patreon: PerfectComboDev
X: @PerfectComboDev
